attempts.text:
This plan costs 166. Tarkeshwar shelter is the only evacuation point, so every rescue ends there.

- **Dhunche village:** One round trip of 22 minutes brings the injured farmer and the two children to safety. This saves 80 + 2×60 = 200 in penalties.
- **Gajuri farm:** A round trip of 64 minutes via Dhunche brings four of the five adults to safety. This saves 80 in penalties, which is more than the 64 driven. A second trip for the fifth adult would cost 64 to save 20, so that adult is deferred.
- **Gosaikunda care home:** Reaching it takes 80 minutes each way, via Dhunche, Gajuri and Kalika farm. That is far more than the 60 penalty for deferring the three adults, so they are deferred.
- **Panchakanya temple:** It is not an evacuation point, so no one is dropped there.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter dhunche-village
load car1 injured 1
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 child 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter dhunche-village
drive car1 dhunche-village gajuri-farm
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 gajuri-farm dhunche-village
drive car1 dhunche-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer gajuri-farm adult 1
defer gosaikunda-care-home adult 3
</plan>
